what_happened: Scene: layout/style 5 (black cabinets, marble counter); knife (knife_7, wooden handle) in a drawer by the sink; board and a red plate with a fish (fish_7) on another counter 2.4 m away. Stage 0 normal for the distance: grasp at 249 (lift 0.44 m), carried across the kitchen, released on the board at 601 (0.075 m from centre); stage 0 at 602. Stage 1 was slow (801 steps vs median 220, p90 478): the gripper hovered over the fish on the plate 650-1300 and closed at 691 (touch, no lift), 1144 (touch, lift 9 mm) and 1199 (air), mostly on the fish's middle/head side; at ~1300 it grasped the fish by the tail fin (hold 1303-1386, lift 0.145) and placed it on the board next to the knife at 1386 (0.121 m from centre). Success at 1403.
self_recovery: Stage 1: three failed closes on the fish (691, 1144, 1199) over ~600 steps before the tail grasp at ~1300 succeeded.
official_criterion_notes: Stage 0 shows 14 one-step drops with reason 'an object left the target' (650-1397) while the knife lies still on the board 0.07 m from its centre; these are contact flickers of the official on-board check, not real undos. The same 1-step flicker appears in s4, s9, s14, s23 and s26.
